integrity: The pathwise optimum and boundary sharpness are proved analytically from the e-BH step-up rule. Exact-rational enumeration is only a finite corroborative check. No independent validation or practical-algorithm guarantee is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an oracle benchmark: the nonnull set and its cardinality are assumed known.
Null evidence is fixed at the e-value \(1\), so null-identification costs are intentionally excluded.
The theorem does not prove that e-PS or another implementable adaptive allocation attains the pooled boundary.
The likelihood-ratio expectation identity requires Wald integrability conditions and retains an exact overshoot term.
title: Multiplicity-sensitive first-passage oracle for full e-BH discovery
